# Templates

This directory stores external formatting templates and reference material.

## Available templates

- `ieee_transactions/` - IEEE Transactions LaTeX template files and sample documents retained for formatting reference.

The active manuscript currently uses the root-level `IEEEtran.cls`.

## How to use this folder

- Use template files as a style reference, not as direct replacements for active manuscript sources.
- Compare formatting requirements here before venue-specific refactors.
- Keep template versions intact to preserve traceability against official sources.

## Maintenance

- Add a short note in commit messages when template files are updated.
- Do not mix manuscript drafts into this folder.
